hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090, dedicated to this project

ppo.limitation: Step-budget runtime estimate; short real GPU optimizer runs do not establish convergence or final success rate.

production_parallel_plan.selection_basis: Analytical resource allocation; no sweep of environment counts. Twelve workers leave four of the 16 available CPU cores for the PPO driver, IPC, and support work.
production_parallel_plan.projection_method: Fit time_per_step(n)=serial_seconds_per_step+parallel_seconds_per_step/n to the existing one- and five-environment GPU measurements.
production_parallel_plan.limitation: An extrapolation from two short measured runs; GPU batching, IPC and the production rollout window can change scaling. The estimate covers the 5,000,000-step budget and does not guarantee convergence.

production_run.timing_limitation: Observed during the one production run, not a sweep of environment counts; early critic warmup excluded from the median.

sampling.benchmark_execution: Historical: 10 environments stepped serially inside one official EnvPool process.

parallel_plan.execution: Spawned environment/renderer processes; official policy/oracle calls retain parent-process environment-index ordering, with IPC and a single parent-process dataset writer.
parallel_plan.estimate_basis: Divide the historical 16.1-hour serial estimate by ten only as an ideal bound; allow extra time for shared GPU rendering, IPC, process setup and writer contention.
parallel_plan.start_requires: Nonzero native-success preflight and sufficient disk capacity; neither requirement is bypassed by parallelism.
parallel_plan.preflight: 30 episodes in one serial environment; unchanged native-success gate.

utilization_limits.serial_sampling_observation_applies_to: Historical benchmark only; the new collection implementation uses a multiprocessing pool.
